description: Retrieves SCP domain routing information via HTTP GET on the "scp-domain-routing-info" resource, optionally with local=true for local-only information.

constraints.statement: The Service Consumer (SCP) shall send an HTTP GET request to the "scp-domain-routing-info" resource URI.
evidence: "The Service Consumer (i.e. SCP) shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI \"scp-domain-routing-info\" document resource."
constraints.why_interesting: This is the core request method and target resource for the operation.

constraints.statement: On success, the NRF shall return 200 OK with SCP Domain Routing Information in the response body.
evidence: "On success, \"200 OK\" shall be returned with SCP Domain Routing Information in response body."
constraints.why_interesting: Defines the required successful status code and payload presence.

constraints.statement: If the SCP Domain Routing Information contains an empty map, it indicates that no SCP domain is registered in the network.
evidence: "SCP Domain Routing Information with empty map indicates that no SCP domain is registered in the network."
constraints.why_interesting: Defines the observable meaning of an empty-map success response.

constraints.statement: On failure, the NRF shall return a 4xx or 5xx response.
evidence: "On failure, the NRF shall return \"4xx/5xx\" response"
constraints.why_interesting: Specifies the allowed failure status code classes.

constraints.statement: On failure, the NRF response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure.
evidence: "the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure."
constraints.why_interesting: Identifies an optional error payload that can be validated in tests.

constraints.statement: To retrieve local SCP Domain Routing Information, the Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the "scp-domain-routing-info" resource URI with the local query parameter set to true.
evidence: "The Service Consumer (i.e. SCP) shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI \"scp-domain-routing-info\" document resource with \"local\" query parameter set to value \"true\"."
constraints.why_interesting: Defines the request variant used for local-only discovery.

constraints.statement: On success for the local query, the NRF shall return 200 OK with local SCP Domain Routing Information in the response body.
evidence: "On success, \"200 OK\" shall be returned with local SCP Domain Routing Information in response body."
constraints.why_interesting: Specifies the required successful response for the local-only variant.

constraints.statement: If the local SCP Domain Routing Information contains an empty map, it indicates that no SCP domain is registered in the producer NRF.
evidence: "SCP Domain Routing Information with empty map indicates that no SCP domain is registered in the producer NRF."
constraints.why_interesting: Defines the observable meaning of an empty-map local response.

constraints.statement: On failure for the local query, the NRF shall return a 4xx or 5xx response.
evidence: "On failure, the NRF shall return \"4xx/5xx\" response"
constraints.why_interesting: Specifies the allowed failure status code classes for the local variant.

constraints.statement: On failure for the local query, the NRF response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure.
evidence: "the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure."
constraints.why_interesting: Identifies an optional error payload for the local-only variant.
